user.title: TP-Link Kasa Cloud
user.description: Enter your TP-Link (Kasa) account credentials. Home Assistant will control your devices through TP-Link's cloud, so they do not need to be on your local network.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate TP-Link Kasa Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: TP-Link rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TP-Link cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: TP-Link rejected these credentials. Note that two-step verification on your TP-Link account is not supported by this integration.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found in this TP-Link account. Tapo devices are not supported; only Kasa devices appear here.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This TP-Link account is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not reauthenticate. Remove and re-add the integration.
